content.short: Courtyard is an RWA marketplace that tokenizes physical collectibles, allowing users to trade graded cards as NFTs.
content.description: Courtyard is a pioneering platform for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), specializing in high-value physical collectibles such as Pokémon and sports cards. By partnering with world-class custodians like Brink's, the protocol ensures that every digital token is backed 1:1 by a vaulted physical item. This bridging of physical and digital markets allows for instant, global, and secure trading of collectibles without the logistical friction of shipping and storage.
content.meta: Courtyard tokenizes physical collectibles for secure on-chain trading. Discover Courtyard and other RWA Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
